The next round is Round 2, closing Apr 15, 2027 (year inferred), for starts by Aug 31, 2027; RTP describes it as typically a smaller round. Admission applications are open all year.
deadline.quote: The application deadline to be considered in Round 1 (commencement of study in following year) is 31 August. The application deadline to be considered in Round 2 (commencement of study in same year) is 15 April.

app_fee.value: ANU says applying for postgraduate research is free
app_fee.quote: Once you have drafted a research proposal and found a potential | supervisor, applying to ANU is easy. And it’s free.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee for research degrees, so no waiver needed

toefl_min.value: HDR programs, study starting on or after Jan 1, 2027: TOEFL iBT 81 overall (Reading 16, Writing 19, Listening 16, Speaking 19); TOEFL iBT taken on or after Jan 21, 2026 must be the TOEFL iBT Australia. Starts before 2027: 80. IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in each band.
toefl_min.quote: Table 8: Minimum requirements for accepted English Language Tests for admission into Higher Degree by Research Programs | TOEFL iBT [excluding Paper Edition and Home Edition] | If completed on or after 21 January 2026, only the TOEFL iBT Australia will be accepted (with an overall grading scale of 0 to 120). | For study commencing on or after 1 January 2027: | Overall score: 81 | Reading: 16 | Writing: 19 | Listening: 16 | Speaking: 19

english_waiver.value: For research degrees, completing a bachelor's of at least 3 years (or a master's of at least 2 years) taught and assessed entirely in English meets the requirement. Indian Class XII (CBSE/ISC) results are not accepted for research degrees, because the senior-secondary route does not apply to HDR. ANU says it grants no waivers beyond these routes.
english_waiver.quote: Prior tertiary education | Completion of a minimum 3 year Bachelor degree or a minimum 2 year Master degree taught and assessed in entirely in English except for courses that are focused on the development of knowledge and skills in a language other than English

also.quote: Prior senior secondary education | 15–17; Tables 3, 4 | 25–26 | Not accepted | There are no waivers in relation to the application of this policy.

supervisor.value: Admission requires written approval from an identified supervisor. Email potential supervisors first, or submit an expression of interest if unsure.
supervisor.quote: Have the written approval of an identified supervisor for the research project/thesis.

also.quote: Once an academic supervisor has been confirmed to support your application you may proceed to step three. | If you are not sure which area of research or supervisor matches your interest please complete an expression of interest and we will get in contact with you.

funding.value: Scholarships are highly competitive and an offer of admission does not guarantee one. First-class honours may generally be needed for scholarship consideration. The RTP stipend is AUD 40,475 per year (2027 base rate); international HDR students can also get the RTP Fee Offset Scholarship alongside the stipend. International tuition is AUD 57,640 a year (indicative).
funding.quote: in general first class honours might be required for consideration for a scholarship. Scholarships are highly competitive and not all applicants that receive an offer of admission to a HDR program will be successful in receiving a scholarship. | Annual indicative fee for international students | $57,640.00

notes: Four-year full-time PhD (academic plan 9680XPHD). Scholarship applicants are considered automatically through the admission application; the application and referee reports must be complete by the round deadline, so submit 2–3 weeks early. Admission is also subject to supervisory capacity.
